goal: Resolve prior purely technical 5070 vs 5071 datum-grid unavailability with official PROJ-data grid; compare full-source displacement and fixed-grid flips under both approximate fallback and available official NADCON5 operation, preserving author-intended CRS STOP.

source.source_geometry_scope: only Point x/y of SHA verified 12h .shp; no DBF rows, animal identifiers, timestamps, 2h holdout or heldout predictions

official_grid.provider: NOAA NADCON5 via OSGeo PROJ-data open grid CDN
official_grid.purpose: EPSG:4269 NAD83 to EPSG:4152 NAD83(HARN) in CONUS, as required for EPSG:5070 to EPSG:5071 candidate CRS comparison
must_record: grid filesize, downloaded original SHA256, TIFF byte-signature, actual PROJ operation and accuracy metadata
pyproj/PROJ version and data directory; grid availability pre and post installation
official_grid.data_safety: Do not commit downloaded TIFF or modified original GPS ZIP; use temporary grid directory isolated from project.

coordinate_outputs: for each raw x/y source Point, compute source-as-5070 WGS84 lon/lat versus source-as-5071 WGS84 lon/lat with exact official NOAA datum grid available; aggregate geodesic offsets quantiles min/median/p95/max in metres
same comparison with original no-grid ballpark fallback as separate baseline, and quantiles of (grid-backed offset minus fallback offset)

map both candidate geographic positions into EPSG:3857 with explicit datum transformation operations; same pre-frozen grid origin x=-12021622.7691 y=5012625.0685 and cell widths 100/250/500/1000/5000m; paired cell equality and flips

include metadata of chosen TransformerGroup operation and whether it is best_available and any warning/unavailable alternative; do not claim position error bound or author native CRS from this comparison
no raw GPS XY, individual positions, timestamp, animal ID or movement route exported

numerical_policy.source_coordinates: the exact same raw XY interpreted alternatively as EPSG5070 or EPSG5071
numerical_policy.geodesic: pyproj.Geod(ellps='WGS84').inv; report metres and descriptive quantiles
numerical_policy.grid_requirements: Force network off after local official grid installed; assert best_available=True for EPSG:5070→EPSG:5071 in a wholly private temporary PROJ user data directory (or record failure and STOP).
numerical_policy.no_posthoc_selection: No changes to CRS candidates, cell widths/origin or choice of points after examining output.

hard_stops: Do not open/read or download 2h heldout original source
Do not rewrite source PRJ or DBF coordinates
Do not use unofficial or unknown-origin datum grid
Do not elevate 5070/5071 to certified native CRS; publisher still declares EPSG:3742
Do not infer GPS precision, migration route, EOG forecast or independent validation
Record inability to download or missing best-available operation rather than fabricate corrected numerical outputs.
